robotera-xhand1-prou-gr00t2-2026-11-16.title: ROBOTERA Launches XHAND 1 Pro-U, Featured in NVIDIA's GR00T 2 DexUMI Demo
robotera-xhand1-prou-gr00t2-2026-11-16.summary: On Nov 16, 2026, ROBOTERA unveiled the XHAND 1 Pro-U dexterous hand and showcased its high-dexterity manipulation capabilities inside NVIDIA's GR00T 2 DexUMI demonstration at CoRL.

china-embodied-ai-funding-shakeout-2026-.title: China Embodied AI Tops RMB 90B Funding in H1 2026 Amid Industry Shakeout
china-embodied-ai-funding-shakeout-2026-.summary: According to TMTPost and ITJuzi, Chinese embodied AI startups raised over RMB 90 billion in H1 2026 (including RMB 1B+ rounds for chipmakers like D-Robotics in September), while over ten robotics firms entered liquidation or shutdown due to broken unit economics.

agile-robots-500m-series-f-2026-11-15.title: Agile Robots Hits $8.5B Valuation with $500M Series F Backed by SoftBank & NVIDIA
agile-robots-500m-series-f-2026-11-15.summary: Munich-based Physical AI company Agile Robots raised $500 million in a Series F round led by SoftBank Group with NVIDIA, Hitachi, and T.Capital participating, reaching an $8.5 billion valuation and $2 billion in total funding to scale industrial deployment.

asus-gallop-humanoid-thor-2026-11-13.title: ASUS Unveils Gallop Factory Humanoid Powered by a Single NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor
asus-gallop-humanoid-thor-2026-11-13.summary: ASUS detailed its Gallop humanoid robot project designed for factory automation, running its entire vision and Physical AI stack onboard a single NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor computer.

gxo-apptronik-expand-partnership-2026-11.title: GXO and Apptronik Sign LOI to Expand Commercial Apollo Humanoid Deployment
gxo-apptronik-expand-partnership-2026-11.summary: Contract logistics giant GXO and Apptronik signed a letter of intent on Nov 12, 2026 to expand operational trials and commercial deployment of Apollo humanoid robots through a Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

beijing-embodied-ai-action-plan-2026-11-.title: Beijing Issues 2026–2028 Action Plan for High-Quality Embodied AI Robotics
beijing-embodied-ai-action-plan-2026-11-.summary: The Beijing Municipal Bureau of Economy and Information Technology released its 2026–2028 action plan on Nov 11 to accelerate core component R&D, open-source embodied foundation models, and real-world commercial deployment.

robbyant-lingbot-touch-2026-11-10.title: Robbyant Open-Sources LingBot-Touch Tactile Model, Boosting Dexterous Success by 13.9%+
robbyant-lingbot-touch-2026-11-10.summary: Ant Group's Robbyant open-sourced the LingBot-Touch tactile foundation model, lifting mean success rates for Diffusion Policy, π0.5, and LingBot-VLA by over 13.9 percentage points across 26 real-robot dexterous hand tasks.

nvidia-corl-2026-gr00t2-isaac-lab-3-2026.title: NVIDIA Introduces Isaac GR00T 2, Isaac Lab 3.0 & Open Benchmarks at CoRL 2026
nvidia-corl-2026-gr00t2-isaac-lab-3-2026.summary: At the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), NVIDIA and ecosystem partners unveiled Isaac GR00T 2, Isaac Lab 3.0, and new open evaluation benchmarks to accelerate Physical AI simulation and sim-to-real transfer.

agility-robotics-nasdaq-aglt-2026-11-05.title: Agility Robotics Lists on Nasdaq as 'AGLT' Following SPAC Merger (~$465M Gross Capital)
agility-robotics-nasdaq-aglt-2026-11-05.summary: Agility Robotics closed its SPAC merger on Nov 4, 2026 and began trading on Nasdaq under ticker AGLT on Nov 5 with approximately $465 million in gross capital, becoming one of the first publicly traded humanoid companies.

sharpa-funding-and-dexterous-hands-2026-.title: Sharpa Discloses RMB 4.5B+ Round at ~RMB 22B Valuation Behind 22-DoF Wave Hand
sharpa-funding-and-dexterous-hands-2026-.summary: Visuotactile hand maker Sharpa raised over RMB 4.5 billion ($618M–$669M) at a ~RMB 22 billion ($3.0B–$3.3B) valuation in August 2026, scaling its 22-DoF Wave hand and humanoid robotics stack.
